name: Tomato Sauce Squeeze- 320 g
subtitle: No Refined Sugar | No Artificial Colors.

ingredients.name: Tomatoes
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Freshly picked tomatoes that add the natural taste to your kid's snack buddy!

ingredients.name: Jaggery
ingredients.shortDesc: Our paediatricians say: Jaggery (or Gud as called in Hindi) is one of the best natural sweeteners. It helps in regulation of body temperature and detoxifies the body. It also prevents constipation and improves digestion.

ingredients.name: Vitamin A
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Carrots, Green leafy vegetables and Eggs

Form: Retinol palmitate

Amount: 510 mcg

Our paediatricians say: Around here we have a saying: Vitamin A keeps the eye-doctors away! And yet it’s amongst the most common deficiencies in preschool children, affecting 62% of kids. For 100% health, we give you 100% of the recommended serving!

ingredients.name: Vitamin D3
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, mushrooms, cheese, egg yolks etc.

Form: Cholecalciferol (vegetarian source lichen)

Amount: 600 IU

 Our paediatricians say: Vitamin D3 is a very underrated mineral for growing children. Your kids may grow out of their clothes, but they'll never grow out of good old natural minerals. For parents with fussy children - slip our supplements into their chocolate milk, they'll never know!

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Oranges, Amla, strawberry etc.

Form: Ascorbic acid

Amount: 20 mg

Our paediatricians say: Vitamin C can stop bruises to the knee! Vitamin C helps form and repair red blood cells, bones, and tissues. In addition, vitamin C helps cuts and wounds heal, boosts the immune system, and keeps infections at bay.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, meats, milk, egg yolk etc.

Form: Cyanocobalamin

Amount: 2.2 mcg

Our paediatricians says: Vitamin B12 is our supermineral. It turns food into energy, which in turn fuels brain development and growth. Most natural B12 is found in animal sources and this is especially good for vegetarians and vegans! As a supermineral, we supply 100% of the recommended serving.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B9
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Spinach, Kiwi, Nuts, Egg yolk, etc.

Form: Dietary folate

Amount: 102 mcg

Our paediatricians say: Folates are important for several functions in the brain and body including the proper formation of the nervous system. Our product supplies approx. 75% of Vitamin B9 RDA per serving.

ingredients.name: Zinc
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Meat, Legumes, Milk, Eggs, etc.

Form: Zinc citrate

Amount: 1 mg

Our paediatricians say: Zinc is one of those rare minerals that’s great all around for your child’s health, including their attention span, motor development, height and weight. Move aside, energy drinks! There’s a new hero on the block.

ingredients.name: Curcumin
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Turmeric

Form: Curcumin

Amount: 5 mg

Our paediatricians say: Curcumin is anti-inflammatory, anti-allergic and antioxidant. It’s great for your child’s immune system, naturally sourced, and can be mixed into anything!

ingredients.name: DHA
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Flaxseed

Form: Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA)

Amount: 15 mg

Our paediatricians say: If there was a nutritional hero, it would be DHA. DHA is vital to the structure of the brain and may improve learning, memory, immunity and inflammation. Vegetarian kids are especially deficient in DHA. Our supplement is vegan and is sourced from flaxseed.

fullIngredientsList: Water, Tomato Paste 28%, Jaggery, Natural Vinegar, Salt, Tapioca Starch, Stabilizer (Xanthan Gum), Spices And Condiments, Paprika Extract.

description:
🍅 Parents, stop the sugar-loaded ketchup and try this yummy, better alternative instead!

💯 Made with 28% Tomato Paste and Sweetened with Jaggery. 

🚫 Zero preservatives, artificial color, and 0 MSG! Contains onion & garlic

Just pour out some tomato sauce and pair it with your kid's favorite snack! 
We do not use preservatives in our ketchup, so we recommend refrigerating it once opened and consuming it within 30 days of opening the bottle. 

For 2–3 year olds, please check with your nutritionist before serving.
